title: The Envelope
heading: BadCode Shorts ▲ The Envelope

beats.name: A. Approved (1)
beats.blurb: An arms-deal envelope lands on a desk, stamped APPROVED BY THE CONSERVATIVE PARTY.

beats.name: B. Approved (2)

beats.name: C. Anyway
beats.blurb: "They're going to print the money anyway."

moodboard_intro: Round 1 (clean room: a sealed writer researched spy-film inserts, Whitehall export paperwork and Nano Banana 2, nothing from the repo). Three looks carried across all three beats so A and B rhyme: a = 1970s Whitehall spy-film insert on 35mm, b = two-colour linocut, c = stop-motion miniature. Pick a column and it cuts as one short. Vote This / Maybe / No and note any beat. 🔴 Owed before posting: marketing-gatekeeper on naming the two parties.
